name: Functional Map of the World (FMoW)
description: A satellite imagery dataset containing high-resolution satellite images annotated with building and land-use functional categories, designed to support recognition across geographic and temporal variation.
citation: Christie, G., Fendley, N., Wilson, J., & Mukherjee, R. (2018). Functional Map of the World. IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR). https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2018.00458
